# optimizelycmp_folder_permission (Resource)

Grants one user or team access to a folder. Destroying it revokes that access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_team" "marketing" {
  name = "Marketing"
}

resource "optimizelycmp_folder_permission" "marketing_edit" {
  folder_id     = optimizelycmp_folder.brand.id
  accessor_id   = data.optimizelycmp_team.marketing.id
  accessor_type = "team"
  access_type   = "edit"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_type` (String) view or edit.
- `accessor_id` (String) ID of the user or team.
- `accessor_type` (String) user or team.
- `folder_id` (String) Folder ID.

### Optional

- `is_owner` (Boolean) Make the accessor the folder owner (users only). The API can only set this to true: ownership moves by making another user owner, so changing true back to false is refused.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <folder_id>/<accessor_id>.
